_doc: Aggregated outcome distribution + framework signal-firing potential for 2019-12-31 → 2022-12-31 COVID-stress backtest of CA NH muni universe with anti-survivorship-bias additions.
_note: Wrote 5 stress-test additions but Eskaton was already in 2025 universe excluded-with-reason list; treating it as an addition for backtest purposes since its 2019 status was active.

false_positives: (None high-confidence) — Atherton + Eskaton both DID experience stress even though bondholders ok

honesty_alpha_implications: WINDOW A HAS REAL DEFAULTS: Anti-survivorship-bias additions (CNMH, Verity Seton, Verity St. Francis) give framework 3 actual default events to test against in window. Plus 1 covenant breach (Eskaton) and 1 BB-rated stress signal (Atherton).

FRAMEWORK SIGNAL-FIRING: At 2019-12-31, framework would correctly flag (a) Verity names trivially (already in BK), (b) CNMH plausibly via small-standalone + Oakland-demographic detectors, (c) Eskaton plausibly via standalone-SNF-concentration detector, (d) Atherton via sub-investment-grade + high-SNF-mix detector.
FALSE-POSITIVE RATE LOW: 11 of 18 obligors had no signal AND no outcome — framework would correctly leave them alone.

CMS DATA EXTRACTION GAP: Star ratings at 2019-Q4 specifically were not pulled from archived ProviderInfo. Most NH-specific signals (SFF, CMP) are LOW-confidence at this historical snapshot. Direct CMS archive download would be required to test NH-specific detectors authoritatively.

CRITICAL LEARNING: Most CA SNF bondholders are insured (Cal-Mortgage). Framework's signal-firing on underlying operator stress is genuine alpha — but realized bondholder losses are rare even where stress is real. Framework should be valued for IDENTIFYING STRESS not just PREDICTING DEFAULT.
